newsitem.title: USA: ABT Building Products to open new plant.
newsitem.headline: ABT Building Products to open new plant.

text.p: ABT Building Products Corp said Thursday it will build a new vinyl siding facility 35 miles southeast of Memphis, Tenn.

The plant, which is expected to cost about $16 million, will double the company's capacity to produce vinyl siding and accessories, ABT Building Products said. The facility is expected to begin production in the third quarter of 1997.
ABT Building Products makes specialty building products for the home improvement, remodeling and commercial markets.
Its shares were trading down 1/2 Thursday at 26-1/4.
